# Phase 2 Implementation Plan: Domain Model

## Goal

Implement the approved domain model inside `BCSMS.Domain` with zero external dependencies. No changes to Application, Infrastructure, API, or test projects.

---

## Current State

The Domain project contains only:
- [`BCSMS.Domain.csproj`](file:///Users/mervebilgin/BursaCityServiceManagement/backend/dotnet/src/BCSMS.Domain/BCSMS.Domain.csproj) — empty class library
- [`Common/DomainAssemblyMarker.cs`](file:///Users/mervebilgin/BursaCityServiceManagement/backend/dotnet/src/BCSMS.Domain/Common/DomainAssemblyMarker.cs) — placeholder

---

## Proposed Directory Structure

```
BCSMS.Domain/
├── Common/
│   ├── BaseEntity.cs              ← shared base with Id + audit timestamps
│   └── DomainException.cs         ← domain-specific exception
│
├── Enums/
│   ├── RequestStatus.cs
│   ├── RequestCategory.cs
│   ├── Priority.cs
│   └── UserRole.cs
│
├── ValueObjects/
│   ├── Location.cs
│   ├── FullName.cs
│   └── ContactInfo.cs
│
└── Entities/
    ├── ServiceRequest.cs          ← aggregate root
    ├── StatusHistoryEntry.cs      ← child of ServiceRequest
    ├── Comment.cs                 ← child of ServiceRequest
    ├── Attachment.cs              ← child of ServiceRequest
    ├── User.cs                    ← aggregate root
    └── Department.cs              ← aggregate root
```

---

## Proposed Changes

### Common Layer

#### [DELETE] `Common/DomainAssemblyMarker.cs`
No longer needed once real entities exist.

#### [NEW] `Common/BaseEntity.cs`
Abstract base class providing:
- `Guid Id` (set once at construction)
- `DateTime CreatedAt`
- `DateTime? UpdatedAt`

> [!NOTE]
> This is a minimal convenience base — not a leaky abstraction. It avoids repeating Id/timestamp boilerplate across all 6 entities. No framework dependency. If any entity needs a different identity type in the future, it can stop inheriting.

#### [NEW] `Common/DomainException.cs`
A simple `DomainException : Exception` class for business rule violations. This keeps domain exceptions distinct from system exceptions, enabling the API layer to map them to HTTP 400/422 responses.

---

### Enums

#### [NEW] `Enums/RequestStatus.cs`
Values: `New`, `Reviewing`, `Assigned`, `InProgress`, `Resolved`, `Closed`, `Rejected`, `Cancelled`

#### [NEW] `Enums/RequestCategory.cs`
Values: `RoadDamage`, `WasteCleaning`, `StreetLighting`, `ParkGarden`, `Flooding`, `NoiseComplaint`, `SocialAssistance`, `Other`

#### [NEW] `Enums/Priority.cs`
Values: `Low`, `Medium`, `High`, `Critical`

#### [NEW] `Enums/UserRole.cs`
Values: `Citizen`, `Employee`, `Manager`, `Admin`

---

### Value Objects

#### [NEW] `ValueObjects/Location.cs`
- Properties: `double Latitude`, `double Longitude`, `string? AddressText`
- Implemented as a `record` (C# records give value equality and immutability for free)
- Validation: latitude ∈ [-90, 90], longitude ∈ [-180, 180]

#### [NEW] `ValueObjects/FullName.cs`
- Properties: `string FirstName`, `string LastName`
- Implemented as a `record`
- Validation: both non-empty

#### [NEW] `ValueObjects/ContactInfo.cs`
- Properties: `string Email`, `string PhoneNumber`
- Implemented as a `record`
- Validation: email non-empty; phone can be empty

---

### Entities

#### [NEW] `Entities/Department.cs` — Aggregate Root
- Inherits `BaseEntity`
- Properties: `string Name`, `string? Description`, `bool IsActive`
- Constructor enforces: name is required
- Method: `Update(name, description)` with validation
- Method: `Deactivate()` / `Activate()`

#### [NEW] `Entities/User.cs` — Aggregate Root
- Inherits `BaseEntity`
- Properties: `FullName Name`, `ContactInfo Contact`, `UserRole Role`, `Guid? DepartmentId`, `bool IsActive`
- Constructor enforces: name and contact required; if Employee/Manager → DepartmentId required; if Citizen → DepartmentId must be null
- No public setters — updates through methods

#### [NEW] `Entities/ServiceRequest.cs` — Aggregate Root
- Inherits `BaseEntity`
- Properties:
  - `string Title`, `string Description`, `RequestCategory Category`
  - `RequestStatus Status` (private set)
  - `Priority? Priority`
  - `Location? Location`
  - `Guid CitizenId` (immutable after construction)
  - `Guid? AssignedDepartmentId`, `Guid? AssignedEmployeeId`
- Private collections:
  - `List<StatusHistoryEntry> _statusHistory` exposed as `IReadOnlyList<StatusHistoryEntry>`
  - `List<Comment> _comments` exposed as `IReadOnlyList<Comment>`
  - `List<Attachment> _attachments` exposed as `IReadOnlyList<Attachment>`
- **State machine methods** (each validates the transition, updates status, and creates a StatusHistoryEntry):
  - `Review(changedByUserId)` — New → Reviewing
  - `Assign(departmentId, employeeId?, priority, changedByUserId)` — Reviewing → Assigned
  - `StartProgress(changedByUserId)` — Assigned → InProgress
  - `Resolve(changedByUserId, note?)` — InProgress → Resolved
  - `Close(changedByUserId, note?)` — Resolved → Closed
  - `Reopen(changedByUserId, note?)` — Resolved → InProgress
  - `Reject(changedByUserId, note?)` — New/Reviewing → Rejected
  - `Cancel(changedByUserId)` — New/Reviewing/Assigned → Cancelled
- **Other methods:**
  - `AddComment(content, createdByUserId)` — guards against terminal states
  - `AddAttachment(fileName, contentType, fileSizeInBytes, storagePath, uploadedByUserId)` — guards against terminal states
  - `UpdateDetails(title?, description?, category?, location?)` — guards against terminal states
  - `SetPriority(priority)` — guards against terminal states

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The state machine is the heart of the domain model. Every transition method checks the current status, throws `DomainException` if invalid, atomically updates `Status`, and appends a `StatusHistoryEntry`. This avoids an anemic model where status changes happen by directly setting a property.

#### [NEW] `Entities/StatusHistoryEntry.cs` — Child Entity
- Inherits `BaseEntity`
- Properties: `Guid ServiceRequestId`, `RequestStatus OldStatus`, `RequestStatus NewStatus`, `string? Note`, `Guid ChangedByUserId`, `DateTime ChangedAt`
- Created only by ServiceRequest's transition methods (constructor is `internal`)

#### [NEW] `Entities/Comment.cs` — Child Entity
- Inherits `BaseEntity`
- Properties: `Guid ServiceRequestId`, `string Content`, `Guid CreatedByUserId`
- Created only via `ServiceRequest.AddComment()` (constructor is `internal`)
- Validation: content non-empty

#### [NEW] `Entities/Attachment.cs` — Child Entity
- Inherits `BaseEntity`
- Properties: `Guid ServiceRequestId`, `string FileName`, `string ContentType`, `long FileSizeInBytes`, `string StoragePath`, `Guid UploadedByUserId`, `DateTime UploadedAt`
- Created only via `ServiceRequest.AddAttachment()` (constructor is `internal`)
- Validation: fileName and storagePath non-empty, fileSizeInBytes > 0

---

## Design Decisions

| Decision | Approach | Rationale |
|----------|----------|-----------|
| **Id type** | `Guid` for all entities | Database-agnostic, no auto-increment dependency |
| **Value objects** | C# `record` types | Free value equality + immutability; concise syntax |
| **Collections** | Private `List<T>`, exposed as `IReadOnlyList<T>` | Encapsulation — external code cannot add/remove items directly |
| **Child entity constructors** | `internal` access modifier | Only the aggregate root can create children; external code cannot instantiate them outside the Domain assembly |
| **State machine** | Explicit methods per transition | Clear API surface; each method validates preconditions and produces side effects (history entry) |
| **Validation** | Guard clauses in constructors and methods | Fail fast; no invalid objects can exist |
| **Domain exception** | Custom `DomainException` class | Distinguishable from system exceptions; API layer can map to 400/422 |
| **EF Core mapping** | NOT in Domain — will be configured in Infrastructure via Fluent API | Domain stays clean; no `[Key]`, `[Required]`, `[Column]` attributes |
| **Private parameterless constructors** | Added for EF Core (with a `// For EF Core` comment) | EF Core needs a parameterless constructor for materialization; making it private keeps the public API clean |

---

## What This Plan Does NOT Include

- ❌ No changes to BCSMS.Application
- ❌ No changes to BCSMS.Infrastructure
- ❌ No changes to BCSMS.API
- ❌ No changes to test projects
- ❌ No NuGet packages added to Domain
- ❌ No EF Core attributes
- ❌ No repository interfaces (those belong in Application — future phase)
- ❌ No DTOs

---

## Verification Plan

### Automated
```bash
cd backend/dotnet
dotnet restore BCSMS.sln
dotnet build BCSMS.sln
```
Must complete with **0 errors, 0 warnings**.

### Manual Review
- Confirm Domain project has zero NuGet package references
- Confirm no `using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore` or `using Microsoft.AspNetCore` appears in any Domain file
- Confirm all state machine transitions are guarded
- Confirm all collections are properly encapsulated
- List final file tree

args.CodeContent:
# Phase 2: Revised Domain Implementation Plan

## Revision Summary

Changes from the original plan based on architectural feedback:

| # | Change | Rationale |
|---|--------|-----------|
| 1 | **RequestCategory enum → Category entity** | Municipalities must add/modify categories without recompilation |
| 2 | **BaseEntity is minimal** — Id only | No global timestamps, soft-delete, or audit fields baked into a base class |
| 3 | **User uses role-based composition** | No inheritance — single User entity with UserRole enum |
| 4 | **Child entities (StatusHistoryEntry, Comment, Attachment) stay inside ServiceRequest aggregate** | No separate repositories or services for them |
| 5 | **Attachment is metadata-only** | No IFormFile, Stream, or storage-provider types in Domain |
| 6 | **No WorkOrder or Assignment entities in MVP** | AssignedDepartmentId and AssignedEmployeeId on ServiceRequest are sufficient |
| 7 | **ServiceRequest is not anemic** | Rich behavior methods with state machine guards |
| 8 | **Status changes auto-create StatusHistoryEntry** | Enforced atomically inside transition methods |

---

## Proposed Directory Structure

```
BCSMS.Domain/
├── Common/
│   ├── BaseEntity.cs                ← Id only
│   └── DomainException.cs           ← domain-specific exception
│
├── Enums/
│   ├── RequestStatus.cs
│   ├── Priority.cs
│   └── UserRole.cs
│
├── ValueObjects/
│   ├── Location.cs
│   ├── FullName.cs
│   └── ContactInfo.cs
│
└── Entities/
    ├── Category.cs                  ← NEW: data-driven, aggregate root
    ├── ServiceRequest.cs            ← aggregate root (rich behavior)
    ├── StatusHistoryEntry.cs        ← child of ServiceRequest
    ├── Comment.cs                   ← child of ServiceRequest
    ├── Attachment.cs                ← child of ServiceRequest
    ├── User.cs                      ← aggregate root
    └── Department.cs                ← aggregate root
```

**15 files** total (was 16 — removed RequestCategory enum, added Category entity).

---

## Proposed Types: Properties & Methods

---

### `Common/BaseEntity.cs`

Minimal abstract base — identity only.

```
abstract class BaseEntity
  Properties:
    Guid Id                          { get; private set; }

  Constructors:
    protected BaseEntity()           — for EF Core
    protected BaseEntity(Guid id)    — validates non-empty
```

> [!IMPORTANT]
> No `CreatedAt`, `UpdatedAt`, or `IsActive` in the base class. Each entity defines only the timestamps and flags it actually needs. This avoids forcing audit concerns onto entities that don't need them.

---

### `Common/DomainException.cs`

```
class DomainException : Exception
  Constructors:
    DomainException(string message)
    DomainException(string message, Exception innerException)
```

---

### `Enums/RequestStatus.cs`

```
enum RequestStatus
  New = 0
  Reviewing = 1
  Assigned = 2
  InProgress = 3
  Resolved = 4
  Closed = 5
  Rejected = 6
  Cancelled = 7
```

---

### `Enums/Priority.cs`

```
enum Priority
  Low = 0
  Medium = 1
  High = 2
  Critical = 3
```

---

### `Enums/UserRole.cs`

```
enum UserRole
  Citizen = 0
  Employee = 1
  Manager = 2
  Admin = 3
```

---

### `ValueObjects/Location.cs`

```
record Location
  Properties:
    double Latitude                  { get; }
    double Longitude                 { get; }
    string? AddressText              { get; }

  Constructor:
    Location(double latitude, double longitude, string? addressText)
    — validates: latitude ∈ [-90, 90], longitude ∈ [-180, 180]
```

---

### `ValueObjects/FullName.cs`

```
record FullName
  Properties:
    string FirstName                 { get; }
    string LastName                  { get; }

  Constructor:
    FullName(string firstName, string lastName)
    — validates: both non-empty, trims whitespace

  Methods:
    override string ToString()       → "FirstName LastName"
```

---

### `ValueObjects/ContactInfo.cs`

```
record ContactInfo
  Properties:
    string Email                     { get; }
    string PhoneNumber               { get; }

  Constructor:
    ContactInfo(string email, string phoneNumber)
    — validates: email non-empty, normalizes to lowercase
    — phoneNumber optional (defaults to empty)
```

---

### `Entities/Category.cs` — Aggregate Root (NEW)

Data-driven service request category. Replaces the former RequestCategory enum.

```
class Category : BaseEntity
  Properties:
    string Name                      { get; private set; }     — e.g. "Road Damage"
    string? Description              { get; private set; }
    bool IsActive                    { get; private set; }
    DateTime CreatedAt               { get; private set; }
    DateTime? UpdatedAt              { get; private set; }

  Constructors:
    private Category()               — for EF Core
    Category(Guid id, string name, string? description)

  Methods:
    void Update(string name, string? description)
    void Activate()
    void Deactivate()

  Invariants:
    — Name is required and non-empty
```

> [!NOTE]
> Category is its own aggregate root because it has an independent lifecycle (created/deactivated by admins), and ServiceRequest references it by ID. Category uniqueness (no duplicate names) is enforced at the Application/Infrastructure layer since it requires a database query.

---

### `Entities/Department.cs` — Aggregate Root

```
class Department : BaseEntity
  Properties:
    string Name                      { get; private set; }
    string? Description              { get; private set; }
    bool IsActive                    { get; private set; }
    DateTime CreatedAt               { get; private set; }
    DateTime? UpdatedAt              { get; private set; }

  Constructors:
    private Department()             — for EF Core
    Department(Guid id, string name, string? description)

  Methods:
    void Update(string name, string? description)
    void Activate()
    void Deactivate()

  Invariants:
    — Name is required and non-empty
```

---

### `Entities/User.cs` — Aggregate Root

Single entity with role-based composition — no subclasses.

```
class User : BaseEntity
  Properties:
    FullName Name                    { get; private set; }
    ContactInfo Contact              { get; private set; }
    UserRole Role                    { get; private set; }
    Guid? DepartmentId               { get; private set; }     — required for Employee/Manager
    bool IsActive                    { get; private set; }
    DateTime CreatedAt               { get; private set; }
    DateTime? UpdatedAt              { get; private set; }

  Constructors:
    private User()                   — for EF Core
    User(Guid id, FullName name, ContactInfo contact, UserRole role, Guid? departmentId)

  Methods:
    void UpdateProfile(FullName name, ContactInfo contact)
    void ChangeRole(UserRole newRole, Guid? departmentId)
    void Activate()
    void Deactivate()

  Invariants:
    — Name and Contact are required
    — Employee/Manager → DepartmentId required
    — Citizen/Admin → DepartmentId must be null
```

---

### `Entities/ServiceRequest.cs` — Aggregate Root (Rich Behavior)

The central entity with encapsulated state machine and child management.

```
class ServiceRequest : BaseEntity
  Properties:
    string Title                     { get; private set; }
    string? Description              { get; private set; }
    Guid CategoryId                  { get; private set; }     — references Category entity by ID
    RequestStatus Status             { get; private set; }
    Priority? Priority               { get; private set; }
    Location? Location               { get; private set; }
    Guid CitizenId                   { get; private set; }     — immutable after creation
    Guid? AssignedDepartmentId       { get; private set; }
    Guid? AssignedEmployeeId         { get; private set; }
    DateTime CreatedAt               { get; private set; }
    DateTime? UpdatedAt              { get; private set; }

  Encapsulated Collections:
    private List<StatusHistoryEntry> _statusHistory
    private List<Comment>            _comments
    private List<Attachment>         _attachments

  Read-Only Accessors:
    IReadOnlyList<StatusHistoryEntry> StatusHistory
    IReadOnlyList<Comment>            Comments
    IReadOnlyList<Attachment>         Attachments

  Constructors:
    private ServiceRequest()         — for EF Core
    ServiceRequest(Guid id, string title, Guid categoryId, Guid citizenId,
                   string? description, Location? location)
    — Status starts as New
    — Validates title non-empty, citizenId non-empty, categoryId non-empty

  State Machine Methods:
    void StartReview(Guid changedByUserId)
        New → Reviewing

    void Assign(Guid departmentId, Guid? employeeId, Priority priority, Guid changedByUserId)
        Reviewing → Assigned
        — departmentId required, priority required

    void StartProgress(Guid changedByUserId)
        Assigned → InProgress

    void Resolve(Guid changedByUserId, string? note)
        InProgress → Resolved

    void Close(Guid changedByUserId, string? note)
        Resolved → Closed

    void Reopen(Guid changedByUserId, string? note)
        Resolved → InProgress

    void Reject(Guid changedByUserId, string? note)
        New | Reviewing → Rejected

    void Cancel(Guid changedByUserId)
        New | Reviewing | Assigned → Cancelled

  Child Management Methods:
    Comment AddComment(string content, Guid createdByUserId)
        — guards against terminal states

    Attachment AddAttachment(string fileName, string contentType,
                             long fileSizeInBytes, string storagePath, Guid uploadedByUserId)
        — guards against terminal states

  Detail Update Methods:
    void UpdateDetails(string? title, string? description, Guid? categoryId, Location? location)
        — guards against terminal states

    void SetPriority(Priority priority)
        — guards against terminal states

  Private Helpers:
    void TransitionTo(RequestStatus newStatus, Guid changedByUserId, string? note)
        — atomically: creates StatusHistoryEntry + updates Status + sets UpdatedAt
    void EnsureValidTransition(RequestStatus expected, RequestStatus target)
    void EnsureNotInTerminalState(string action)
```

---

### `Entities/StatusHistoryEntry.cs` — Child of ServiceRequest

```
class StatusHistoryEntry : BaseEntity
  Properties:
    Guid ServiceRequestId            { get; private set; }
    RequestStatus OldStatus          { get; private set; }
    RequestStatus NewStatus          { get; private set; }
    string? Note                     { get; private set; }
    Guid ChangedByUserId             { get; private set; }
    DateTime ChangedAt               { get; private set; }

  Constructors:
    private StatusHistoryEntry()     — for EF Core
    internal StatusHistoryEntry(Guid id, Guid serviceRequestId,
        RequestStatus oldStatus, RequestStatus newStatus,
        Guid changedByUserId, string? note)
```

---

### `Entities/Comment.cs` — Child of ServiceRequest

```
class Comment : BaseEntity
  Properties:
    Guid ServiceRequestId            { get; private set; }
    string Content                   { get; private set; }
    Guid CreatedByUserId             { get; private set; }
    DateTime CreatedAt               { get; private set; }

  Constructors:
    private Comment()                — for EF Core
    internal Comment(Guid id, Guid serviceRequestId, string content, Guid createdByUserId)
    — validates: content non-empty

  Note: Comment has its own CreatedAt because it needs a timestamp,
        but this is defined on Comment itself, not inherited from BaseEntity.
```

---

### `Entities/Attachment.cs` — Child of ServiceRequest

```
class Attachment : BaseEntity
  Properties:
    Guid ServiceRequestId            { get; private set; }
    string FileName                  { get; private set; }
    string ContentType               { get; private set; }
    long FileSizeInBytes             { get; private set; }
    string StoragePath               { get; private set; }     — opaque key, only Infrastructure resolves
    Guid UploadedByUserId            { get; private set; }
    DateTime UploadedAt              { get; private set; }

  Constructors:
    private Attachment()             — for EF Core
    internal Attachment(Guid id, Guid serviceRequestId, string fileName,
        string contentType, long fileSizeInBytes, string storagePath,
        Guid uploadedByUserId)
    — validates: fileName, contentType, storagePath non-empty; fileSizeInBytes > 0
```

---

## Key Design Decisions (Revised)

| Decision | Approach | Rationale |
|----------|----------|-----------|
| **Category** | Data-driven entity (not enum) | Municipalities can add categories at runtime without recompilation |
| **BaseEntity** | Id only — no timestamps | Each entity declares only the fields it actually needs |
| **User roles** | Single entity + UserRole enum | No inheritance; role-based composition is sufficient |
| **Child constructors** | `internal` | Only the aggregate root (ServiceRequest) can create children |
| **Collections** | Private `List<T>`, public `IReadOnlyList<T>` | Encapsulation — no external mutation |
| **State machine** | Explicit methods per transition | Each method guards, transitions, and records history atomically |
| **Timestamps** | Per-entity (`CreatedAt`, `UpdatedAt` where needed) | Not forced through base class |
| **Value objects** | C# `record` types | Free value equality + immutability |
| **Cross-aggregate refs** | ID only (Guid) | No navigation properties between aggregates |

---

## What Is NOT Included

- ❌ No RequestCategory enum (replaced by Category entity)
- ❌ No WorkOrder entity
- ❌ No Assignment entity
- ❌ No global audit timestamps in BaseEntity
- ❌ No repository interfaces (Application layer — future phase)
- ❌ No EF Core attributes or usings
- ❌ No NuGet packages in Domain

---

## Verification Plan

```bash
cd backend/dotnet
dotnet restore BCSMS.sln
dotnet build BCSMS.sln
```
Must pass with **0 errors, 0 warnings**.

Post-build checks:
- Domain csproj has zero `<PackageReference>` entries
- No `using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore` or `using Microsoft.AspNetCore` in any Domain file
- All state transitions are guarded
- All collections are encapsulated

| 2 | CategoryId is required (non-empty Guid) | Constructor + `ChangeCategory()` |
| 3 | CitizenId is required and immutable | Constructor only, no setter |
| 4 | Status transitions follow the state machine | `EnsureValidTransition()` guard in each method |
| 5 | Assignment requires DepartmentId | `Assign()` guard |
| 6 | Priority must be set during assignment | `Assign()` requires priority parameter |
| 7 | Terminal states are immutable | `EnsureNotInTerminalState()` on all mutations |
| 8 | Every status change creates a StatusHistoryEntry | `TransitionTo()` creates entry atomically |
| 9 | Cancellation blocked once InProgress | `Cancel()` guard |
| 10 | Comments blocked on terminal states | `AddComment()` guard |
| 11 | Attachments blocked on terminal states | `AddAttachment()` guard |

### User
| # | Invariant | Enforcement |
|---|-----------|-------------|
| 12 | Name and Contact are required | Constructor + `UpdateProfile()` |
| 13 | Employee/Manager must have DepartmentId | `ValidateDepartmentForRole()` |
| 14 | Citizen/Admin must NOT have DepartmentId | `ValidateDepartmentForRole()` |

### Category / Department
| # | Invariant | Enforcement |
|---|-----------|-------------|
| 15 | Name is required (non-empty) | Constructor + `Update()` via `SetName()` |

### Value Objects
| # | Invariant | Enforcement |
|---|-----------|-------------|
| 16 | Location latitude ∈ [-90, 90] | Location constructor |
| 17 | Location longitude ∈ [-180, 180] | Location constructor |
| 18 | FullName first/last both required | FullName constructor |
| 19 | ContactInfo email required | ContactInfo constructor |

### Attachment
| # | Invariant | Enforcement |
|---|-----------|-------------|
| 20 | FileName, ContentType, StoragePath required | Internal constructor |
| 21 | FileSizeInBytes > 0 | Internal constructor |

### Comment
| # | Invariant | Enforcement |
|---|-----------|-------------|
| 22 | Content required (non-empty) | Internal constructor |

---

## ServiceRequest State Transitions

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> New : Constructor

    New --> Reviewing : StartReview()
    New --> Rejected : Reject()
    New --> Cancelled : Cancel()

    Reviewing --> Assigned : Assign()
    Reviewing --> Rejected : Reject()
    Reviewing --> Cancelled : Cancel()

    Assigned --> InProgress : StartProgress()
    Assigned --> Cancelled : Cancel()

    InProgress --> Resolved : Resolve()

    Resolved --> Closed : Close()
    Resolved --> InProgress : Reopen()

    Closed --> [*]
    Rejected --> [*]
    Cancelled --> [*]
```

**9 transition methods**, **3 terminal states**, **all guarded by domain invariants**.

---

## Key Design Decisions Enforced

| Decision | Implementation |
|----------|---------------|
| No `DateTime.UtcNow` in Domain | All timestamps are `DateTime utcNow` parameters supplied by caller |
| Minimal BaseEntity | Contains only `Guid Id` — no global timestamps |
| Category is data-driven | Entity with its own lifecycle, referenced by ID from ServiceRequest |
| Explicit behavior methods | `UpdateTitle`, `UpdateDescription`, `ChangeCategory`, `ChangeLocation`, `RemoveLocation` instead of a single `UpdateDetails` |
| No authorization in Domain | State machine validates lifecycle rules only; role/permission checks belong in Application |
| `ContactInfo.PhoneNumber` is `string?` | Null represents absence, not empty string |
| Internal child constructors | `StatusHistoryEntry`, `Comment`, `Attachment` have `internal` constructors |
| Encapsulated collections | Private `List<T>`, public `IReadOnlyList<T>` |
| Value objects as records | C# records provide value equality and immutability |

---

## What Was NOT Changed

- ❌ BCSMS.Application — unchanged
- ❌ BCSMS.Infrastructure — unchanged
- ❌ BCSMS.API — unchanged
- ❌ Test projects — unchanged

# Phase 3: Persistence Implementation Plan

## 1. Database Tables

| Table | Source Entity | Type |
|-------|--------------|------|
| `Users` | User | Aggregate root |
| `Departments` | Department | Aggregate root |
| `Categories` | Category | Aggregate root |
| `ServiceRequests` | ServiceRequest | Aggregate root |
| `StatusHistoryEntries` | StatusHistoryEntry | Child of ServiceRequest |
| `Comments` | Comment | Child of ServiceRequest |
| `Attachments` | Attachment | Child of ServiceRequest |

**7 tables total.**

---

## 2. Primary Keys

All tables use `Guid Id` as primary key (from `BaseEntity`). EF Core will be configured with `ValueGeneratedNever()` since IDs are assigned by the domain constructor.

---

## 3. Foreign Keys

| Table | Column | References | Nullable |
|-------|--------|------------|----------|
| `Users` | `DepartmentId` | `Departments.Id` | Yes |
| `ServiceRequests` | `CitizenId` | `Users.Id` | No |
| `ServiceRequests` | `CategoryId` | `Categories.Id` | No |
| `ServiceRequests` | `AssignedDepartmentId` | `Departments.Id` | Yes |
| `ServiceRequests` | `AssignedEmployeeId` | `Users.Id` | Yes |
| `StatusHistoryEntries` | `ServiceRequestId` | `ServiceRequests.Id` | No |
| `StatusHistoryEntries` | `ChangedByUserId` | `Users.Id` | No |
| `Comments` | `ServiceRequestId` | `ServiceRequests.Id` | No |
| `Comments` | `CreatedByUserId` | `Users.Id` | No |
| `Attachments` | `ServiceRequestId` | `ServiceRequests.Id` | No |
| `Attachments` | `UploadedByUserId` | `Users.Id` | No |

---

## 4. Required vs Nullable Columns

### Users
| Column | Required | MaxLength |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| Id | ✅ | — |
| Name_FirstName | ✅ | 100 |
| Name_LastName | ✅ | 100 |
| Contact_Email | ✅ | 256 |
| Contact_PhoneNumber | ❌ | 20 |
| Role | ✅ | 20 (string) |
| DepartmentId | ❌ | — |
| IsActive | ✅ | — |
| CreatedAt | ✅ | — |
| UpdatedAt | ❌ | — |

### Departments
| Column | Required | MaxLength |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| Id | ✅ | — |
| Name | ✅ | 200 |
| Description | ❌ | 1000 |
| IsActive | ✅ | — |
| CreatedAt | ✅ | — |
| UpdatedAt | ❌ | — |

### Categories
| Column | Required | MaxLength |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| Id | ✅ | — |
| Name | ✅ | 200 |
| Description | ❌ | 1000 |
| IsActive | ✅ | — |
| CreatedAt | ✅ | — |
| UpdatedAt | ❌ | — |

### ServiceRequests
| Column | Required | MaxLength |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| Id | ✅ | — |
| Title | ✅ | 300 |
| Description | ❌ | 4000 |
| CategoryId | ✅ | — |
| Status | ✅ | 20 (string) |
| Priority | ❌ | 20 (string) |
| Location_Latitude | ❌ | — |
| Location_Longitude | ❌ | — |
| Location_AddressText | ❌ | 500 |
| CitizenId | ✅ | — |
| AssignedDepartmentId | ❌ | — |
| AssignedEmployeeId | ❌ | — |
| CreatedAt | ✅ | — |
| UpdatedAt | ❌ | — |

### StatusHistoryEntries
| Column | Required | MaxLength |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| Id | ✅ | — |
| ServiceRequestId | ✅ | — |
| OldStatus | ✅ | 20 (string) |
| NewStatus | ✅ | 20 (string) |
| Note | ❌ | 2000 |
| ChangedByUserId | ✅ | — |
| ChangedAt | ✅ | — |

### Comments
| Column | Required | MaxLength |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| Id | ✅ | — |
| ServiceRequestId | ✅ | — |
| Content | ✅ | 4000 |
| CreatedByUserId | ✅ | — |
| CreatedAt | ✅ | — |

### Attachments
| Column | Required | MaxLength |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| Id | ✅ | — |
| ServiceRequestId | ✅ | — |
| FileName | ✅ | 500 |
| ContentType | ✅ | 100 |
| FileSizeInBytes | ✅ | — |
| StoragePath | ✅ | 1000 |
| UploadedByUserId | ✅ | — |
| UploadedAt | ✅ | — |

---

## 5. Unique Indexes

| Table | Column(s) | Rationale |
|-------|-----------|-----------|
| `Users` | `Contact_Email` | Email must be unique across all users |
| `Departments` | `Name` | Department names must be unique |
| `Categories` | `Name` | Category names must be unique |

---

## 6. Normal Indexes

| Table | Column(s) | Rationale |
|-------|-----------|-----------|
| `ServiceRequests` | `Status` | Filter by status (most common query) |
| `ServiceRequests` | `CategoryId` | Filter by category |
| `ServiceRequests` | `CitizenId` | "My requests" query |
| `ServiceRequests` | `AssignedDepartmentId` | Department workload queries |
| `ServiceRequests` | `AssignedEmployeeId` | Employee workload queries |
| `ServiceRequests` | `CreatedAt` | Sort/filter by date |
| `StatusHistoryEntries` | `ServiceRequestId` | Load history for a request (FK index) |
| `Comments` | `ServiceRequestId` | Load comments for a request (FK index) |
| `Attachments` | `ServiceRequestId` | Load attachments for a request (FK index) |

> [!NOTE]
> SQL Server automatically creates indexes for primary keys. EF Core also auto-creates indexes for FK columns in many cases. We'll explicitly define the non-FK indexes listed above.

---

## 7. Value Object Mapping Strategy

### FullName (on User) — `ComplexProperty`

EF Core 8 `ComplexProperty` is ideal for required, non-nullable value objects. FullName is always present on User.

Maps to columns: `Name_FirstName`, `Name_LastName` on the `Users` table. No separate table.

### ContactInfo (on User) — `ComplexProperty`

Same rationale. Always present on User.

Maps to columns: `Contact_Email`, `Contact_PhoneNumber` on the `Users` table.

### Location (on ServiceRequest) — `OwnsOne`

Location is **nullable** on ServiceRequest. `ComplexProperty` does not support nullable instances in EF Core 8. Therefore, `OwnsOne` is the correct choice. EF Core maps the owned type's properties as nullable columns on the `ServiceRequests` table.

Maps to columns: `Location_Latitude`, `Location_Longitude`, `Location_AddressText` on `ServiceRequests`.

---

## 8. Enum Persistence Strategy — String Conversion

**Strategy: Store enums as strings.**

| Enum | Max string length | Example stored value |
|------|------------------|---------------------|
| `RequestStatus` | 20 | `"InProgress"` |
| `Priority` | 20 | `"Critical"` |
| `UserRole` | 20 | `"Employee"` |

**Rationale:**
- Database rows are human-readable without needing an enum lookup
- Enum value reordering won't corrupt existing data
- Adding new enum values doesn't affect storage
- The performance cost is negligible for this application's scale
- Implemented via `HasConversion<string>()` in Fluent API

---

## 9. ServiceRequest Child-Entity Relationships

| Parent | Child | Relationship | Navigation |
|--------|-------|-------------|------------|
| ServiceRequest | StatusHistoryEntry | 1:N | Via backing field `_statusHistory` |
| ServiceRequest | Comment | 1:N | Via backing field `_comments` |
| ServiceRequest | Attachment | 1:N | Via backing field `_attachments` |

EF Core will be configured to use `.HasMany` with `.WithOne()` and access the private backing fields via `UsePropertyAccessMode(PropertyAccessMode.Field)`.

---

## 10. Delete Behaviors

| FK Relationship | Delete Behavior | Rationale |
|----------------|-----------------|-----------|
| User.DepartmentId → Department | **Restrict** | Cannot delete a department with existing users |
| ServiceRequest.CitizenId → User | **Restrict** | Cannot delete a user with existing requests |
| ServiceRequest.CategoryId → Category | **Restrict** | Cannot delete a category with existing requests |
| ServiceRequest.AssignedDepartmentId → Department | **Restrict** | Must not cascade-delete requests |
| ServiceRequest.AssignedEmployeeId → User | **Restrict** | Must not cascade-delete requests |
| StatusHistoryEntry.ServiceRequestId → ServiceRequest | **Cascade** | History deleted with request |
| StatusHistoryEntry.ChangedByUserId → User | **Restrict** | Must not cascade-delete history |
| Comment.ServiceRequestId → ServiceRequest | **Cascade** | Comments deleted with request |
| Comment.CreatedByUserId → User | **Restrict** | Must not cascade-delete comments |
| Attachment.ServiceRequestId → ServiceRequest | **Cascade** | Attachments deleted with request |
| Attachment.UploadedByUserId → User | **Restrict** | Must not cascade-delete attachments |

---

## 11. EF Core Compatibility Analysis

### Private parameterless constructors
✅ All entities have `private` parameterless constructors — EF Core can use these via reflection for materialization.

### Private setters
✅ All properties have `private set` — EF Core can set these via reflection.

### Internal constructors (child entities)
✅ `StatusHistoryEntry`, `Comment`, `Attachment` have `internal` constructors. EF Core doesn't use the public/internal constructors; it uses the private parameterless one.

### Private backing fields for collections
⚠️ `ServiceRequest._statusHistory`, `_comments`, `_attachments` are `private readonly` fields. EF Core can access them via `UsePropertyAccessMode(PropertyAccessMode.Field)` if we tell it the backing field name.

### Record types (value objects)
⚠️ `Location`, `FullName`, `ContactInfo` are C# records with no parameterless constructor. For `ComplexProperty`, EF Core 8 can construct them via the parameterized constructor if the parameter names match the property names (which they do — C# record convention). For `OwnsOne`, same applies. **No Domain changes needed.**

---

## 12. DbSet Exposure

| DbSet | Rationale |
|-------|-----------|

# Phase 3: Persistence & EF Core Integration — Walkthrough

## Summary of Completed Work

In Phase 3, we implemented the database persistence layer inside `BCSMS.Infrastructure` using Entity Framework Core 8 and SQL Server.

All architectural and domain boundaries were preserved:
- **Zero changes to `BCSMS.Domain`**: no EF Core attributes, no navigation properties added just for EF, zero NuGet package references.
- **Fluent API configuration only**: clean entity mapping via `IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>` in separate configuration files.
- **Aggregate Roots only on DbContext**: `BcsmsDbContext` exposes `DbSet<T>` only for `User`, `Department`, `Category`, and `ServiceRequest`.
- **Value Objects cleanly mapped**: `FullName` and `ContactInfo` are mapped inline on `Users` table; `Location` is mapped inline on `ServiceRequests` table with nullable coordinates and address.
- **Enums stored as strings**: `RequestStatus`, `Priority`, and `UserRole` are stored as strings with `HasConversion<string>()`.
- **Strict delete behaviors**: `Restrict` on all cross-aggregate references to protect historical municipal data; `Cascade` strictly on `ServiceRequest`-owned child records (`StatusHistoryEntries`, `Comments`, `Attachments`).

# Phase 4 Implementation Plan: Application Layer & Service Request Use Cases

## 1. Overview & Goal

The goal of Phase 4 is to build a clean, framework-independent Application layer and implement the first vertical slice for municipal service requests without introducing MediatR, CQRS, or generic repository overhead.

---

## 2. Proposed Application Folder Structure

```
BCSMS.Application/
├── Abstractions/
│   ├── Persistence/
│   │   ├── IServiceRequestRepository.cs
│   │   ├── ICategoryRepository.cs
│   │   └── IUserRepository.cs
│   └── Time/
│       └── IClock.cs
│
├── Common/
│   ├── Exceptions/
│   │   ├── NotFoundException.cs
│   │   ├── ForbiddenException.cs
│   │   ├── ValidationException.cs
│   │   └── ApplicationConflictException.cs
│   └── Models/
│       └── PagedResult.cs
│
├── ServiceRequests/
│   ├── Common/
│   │   ├── LocationDto.cs
│   │   ├── StatusHistoryEntryDto.cs
│   │   ├── CommentDto.cs
│   │   └── AttachmentDto.cs
│   ├── Create/
│   │   ├── CreateServiceRequestCommand.cs
│   │   └── CreateServiceRequestResponse.cs
│   ├── GetMy/
│   │   ├── GetMyServiceRequestsQuery.cs
│   │   └── ServiceRequestSummaryDto.cs
│   ├── GetById/
│   │   ├── GetServiceRequestByIdQuery.cs
│   │   └── ServiceRequestDetailDto.cs
│   ├── IServiceRequestService.cs
│   └── ServiceRequestService.cs
│
└── DependencyInjection.cs
```

---

## 3. Proposed Repository & Clock Interfaces

### `IClock`
```csharp
namespace BCSMS.Application.Abstractions.Time;

public interface IClock
{
    DateTime UtcNow { get; }
}
```

### `IServiceRequestRepository`
```csharp
namespace BCSMS.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;

public interface IServiceRequestRepository
{
    Task AddAsync(ServiceRequest serviceRequest, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    Task<ServiceRequest?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    Task<(IReadOnlyList<ServiceRequest> Items, int TotalCount)> GetByCitizenIdAsync(
        Guid citizenId,
        RequestStatus? statusFilter,
        int pageNumber,
        int pageSize,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}
```

### `ICategoryRepository`
```csharp
namespace BCSMS.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;

public interface ICategoryRepository
{
    Task<Category?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}
```

### `IUserRepository`
```csharp
namespace BCSMS.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;

public interface IUserRepository
{
    Task<User?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}
```

> [!NOTE]
> No repositories are created for `Comment`, `Attachment`, or `StatusHistoryEntry` as they are strictly children of the `ServiceRequest` aggregate.

---

## 4. DTOs and Contracts

### Common / Pagination
- `PagedResult<T>`: `Items`, `PageNumber`, `PageSize`, `TotalCount`, `TotalPages`, `HasPreviousPage`, `HasNextPage`.
- `LocationDto`: `Latitude`, `Longitude`, `AddressText`.

### Use Case 1: CreateServiceRequest
- **Command (`CreateServiceRequestCommand`)**:
  - `Guid CitizenId`
  - `string Title`
  - `string? Description`
  - `Guid CategoryId`
  - `double? Latitude`
  - `double? Longitude`
  - `string? AddressText`
- **Response (`CreateServiceRequestResponse`)**:
  - `Guid Id`
  - `string Title`
  - `Guid CategoryId`
  - `Guid CitizenId`
  - `RequestStatus Status`
  - `DateTime CreatedAt`

### Use Case 2: GetMyServiceRequests
- **Query (`GetMyServiceRequestsQuery`)**:
  - `Guid CitizenId`
  - `RequestStatus? StatusFilter`
  - `int PageNumber = 1`
  - `int PageSize = 10`
- **Item DTO (`ServiceRequestSummaryDto`)**:
  - `Guid Id`
  - `string Title`
  - `Guid CategoryId`
  - `RequestStatus Status`
  - `Priority? Priority`
  - `LocationDto? Location`
  - `DateTime CreatedAt`

### Use Case 3: GetServiceRequestById
- **Query (`GetServiceRequestByIdQuery`)**:
  - `Guid RequestId`
  - `Guid RequestingUserId`
- **Detail DTO (`ServiceRequestDetailDto`)**:
  - `Guid Id`
  - `string Title`
  - `string? Description`
  - `Guid CategoryId`
  - `RequestStatus Status`
  - `Priority? Priority`
  - `LocationDto? Location`
  - `Guid CitizenId`
  - `Guid? AssignedDepartmentId`
  - `Guid? AssignedEmployeeId`
  - `DateTime CreatedAt`
  - `DateTime? UpdatedAt`
  - `IReadOnlyList<StatusHistoryEntryDto> StatusHistory`
  - `IReadOnlyList<CommentDto> Comments`
  - `IReadOnlyList<AttachmentDto> Attachments`

---

## 5. Error & Exception Strategy

Application exceptions represent expected use-case validation / business failure cases without coupling to HTTP status codes:

- `NotFoundException(string entityName, object key)` — thrown when Citizen, Category, or ServiceRequest is not found.
- `ForbiddenException(string message)` — thrown when a non-citizen attempts to create a request, or a citizen attempts to view someone else's request.
- `ValidationException(string message)` — thrown when input shape is invalid (e.g., latitude without longitude, page number <= 0).
- `ApplicationConflictException(string message)` — thrown when an entity is in an invalid state for the operation (e.g., citizen or category is deactivated).

These exceptions will be caught by API middleware in future phases and mapped to 404, 403, 400, and 409/422 responses.

---

## 6. SaveChanges & Persistence Strategy

**Decision: Single-step persistence inside command repository methods (`AddAsync`).**

- When `IServiceRequestRepository.AddAsync(serviceRequest, cancellationToken)` is called, the repository adds the entity to `BcsmsDbContext` and awaits `SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken)`.
- **Rationale**: For this MVP, each command use-case modifies a single aggregate. Embedding `SaveChangesAsync` into the repository mutation operation keeps use-case orchestration simple and clean, avoiding premature `IUnitOfWork` abstractions while guaranteeing atomic persistence.

---

## 7. Infrastructure Implementation Details

In `BCSMS.Infrastructure`:
1. `Time/SystemClock.cs` implementing `IClock` (`DateTime.UtcNow`).
2. `Persistence/Repositories/ServiceRequestRepository.cs` implementing `IServiceRequestRepository` using `BcsmsDbContext` with `AsNoTracking()` for read queries and explicit loading of child collections only for `GetByIdAsync`.
3. `Persistence/Repositories/CategoryRepository.cs` implementing `ICategoryRepository` using `BcsmsDbContext` with `AsNoTracking()`.
4. `Persistence/Repositories/UserRepository.cs` implementing `IUserRepository` using `BcsmsDbContext` with `AsNoTracking()`.
5. Update `Infrastructure/DependencyInjection.cs` to register `IClock`, `IServiceRequestRepository`, `ICategoryRepository`, `IUserRepository`.
6. Update `Application/DependencyInjection.cs` to register `IServiceRequestService`.

---

## 8. Domain Changes

**No changes to `BCSMS.Domain` are necessary.**
The existing Domain model constructors, value objects, and encapsulation cleanly satisfy all use-case requirements.

---

## 9. Unit Testing Strategy

Add `BCSMS.UnitTests` test classes for Application use cases using lightweight fakes / mocks:
- `CreateServiceRequestTests`:
  - Active citizen + active category -> creates and returns response DTO
  - Nonexistent citizen -> throws `NotFoundException`
  - Inactive citizen -> throws `ApplicationConflictException`
  - Non-citizen role -> throws `ForbiddenException`
  - Nonexistent category -> throws `NotFoundException`
  - Inactive category -> throws `ApplicationConflictException`
  - Inconsistent coordinates (latitude without longitude) -> throws `ValidationException`
- `GetMyServiceRequestsTests`:
  - Returns only citizen's requests with proper pagination
  - Filters by `RequestStatus` when specified
  - Rejects invalid page number / page size
- `GetServiceRequestByIdTests`:
  - Owner citizen accesses request -> returns detail DTO with history, comments, attachments
  - Different user accesses request -> throws `ForbiddenException`
  - Nonexistent request -> throws `NotFoundException`

---

## 10. Verification Plan

1. `dotnet restore BCSMS.sln`
2. `dotnet build BCSMS.sln` (0 errors, 0 warnings)
3. `dotnet test BCSMS.sln` (all unit tests passing)

# Phase 4: Application Layer & Service Request Use Cases — Walkthrough

## Summary of Completed Work

In Phase 4, we built the Application layer for the **Bursa City Service Management System (BCSMS)**, implementing the first complete vertical slice for municipal service requests without introducing MediatR, CQRS, or generic repository overhead.

### Key Architectural Decisions Implemented:
1. **Clean Architecture Adherence**: `BCSMS.Application` depends **only** on `BCSMS.Domain`. No EF Core, ASP.NET Core, or Infrastructure references.
2. **Deterministic Time Abstraction**: `IClock` abstraction in Application (`UtcNow`), implemented by `SystemClock` in Infrastructure.
3. **No Domain Model Leaks**: Request/response DTOs for all operations.
4. **Single-Query Read Projections with CategoryName**: `ServiceRequestSummaryDto` and `ServiceRequestDetailDto` include `CategoryName` joined directly in SQL without N+1 query overhead.
5. **Separation of Aggregate vs Read Models**: `IServiceRequestRepository.GetByIdAsync` retrieves the domain aggregate for mutations, while `GetDetailByIdAsync` and `GetSummariesByCitizenIdAsync` return optimized, read-only DTO projections using `AsNoTracking()`.
6. **Explicit Validation & Error Model**: Simple, strongly-typed application exceptions (`NotFoundException`, `ForbiddenException`, `ValidationException`, `ApplicationConflictException`) without HTTP coupling.

---

### 3. Repository Abstractions

- `IUserRepository`: `GetByIdAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken ct)`

  - `AddAsync(ServiceRequest serviceRequest, CancellationToken ct)` — aggregate mutation + persistence
  - `GetByIdAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken ct)` — aggregate retrieval
  - `GetDetailByIdAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken ct)` — single-query read projection with `CategoryName`
  - `GetSummariesByCitizenIdAsync(Guid citizenId, RequestStatus? statusFilter, int pageNumber, int pageSize, CancellationToken ct)` — paginated read projection with `CategoryName`

---

### 4. Infrastructure Implementations

- `SystemClock`: Simple UTC clock implementation (`DateTime.UtcNow`).
- `ServiceRequestRepository`: Uses EF Core LINQ projections joining `ServiceRequests` and `Categories` in a single SQL query with `.AsNoTracking()`, preventing N+1 queries.

---

### 5. Use Cases Implemented

1. **`CreateServiceRequest`**:
   - Validates input format, lengths, and coordinate pairs (`Latitude` and `Longitude` must be provided together).
   - Validates that the citizen exists, is active, and possesses the `Citizen` role.
   - Validates that the category exists and is active.
   - Constructs the `Location` value object only when coordinates are supplied.
   - Instantiates the `ServiceRequest` aggregate with deterministic time from `IClock`.
   - Persists and returns `CreateServiceRequestResponse`.
2. **`GetMyServiceRequests`**:
   - Retrieves citizen's requests ordered by `CreatedAt DESC`.
   - Supports optional `RequestStatus` filtering and pagination bounds validation.
   - Returns lightweight `ServiceRequestSummaryDto` instances containing `CategoryName`.
3. **`GetServiceRequestById`**:
   - Enforces citizen ownership (owner citizen can view; other users receive `ForbiddenException`).
   - Returns full `ServiceRequestDetailDto` with `CategoryName`, status history, comments, and attachments in a single database roundtrip.

---

### 6. Validation & Error Strategy

- Validation is performed explicitly in the Application service methods before domain execution.
- Domain rules (e.g. state transitions) remain strictly in Domain entities.
- Error model:
  - `NotFoundException` (entity not found)
  - `ForbiddenException` (role or ownership violation)
  - `ValidationException` (malformed input, pagination bounds)
  - `ApplicationConflictException` (deactivated user or category)

# Phase 5 Implementation Plan: Authentication, Authorization & Web API

## 1. Password Storage & Domain Design Proposal

### Analysis of Current Domain Model
Currently, `BCSMS.Domain.Entities.User` does not store a password hash.

### Options Analyzed:
- **Option A: Store `PasswordHash` on `User` entity**:
  - `public string PasswordHash { get; private set; }` on `User`.
  - The domain entity only holds the hash string and validates that it is non-empty (`!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(passwordHash)`).
  - The domain does **not** contain any hashing, salting, or cryptographic logic.
  - Hashing and verification are handled by `IPasswordHasher` in Application/Infrastructure.
- **Option B: Separate `UserCredential` entity/table**:
  - Requires extra table, extra entity, and a join on every authentication query. Over-engineered for this MVP.
- **Option C: External identity store**:
  - Violates monolithic case-study simplicity.

### Recommendation: Option A (PasswordHash on User)
- **Smallest clean change**: Add `string passwordHash` property and constructor parameter to `User.cs`, plus an `UpdatePasswordHash` method.
- Updates `UserConfiguration.cs` with `.Property(u => u.PasswordHash).HasMaxLength(500).IsRequired()`.
- Add a new migration `AddUserPasswordHash`.

---

## 2. Proposed Project Structure for Phase 5

```
backend/dotnet/
├── src/
│   ├── BCSMS.Application/
│   │   ├── Abstractions/
│   │   │   ├── Persistence/
│   │   │   │   └── IUserRepository.cs (+ GetByEmailAsync, ExistsByEmailAsync, AddAsync)
│   │   │   └── Security/
│   │   │       ├── IPasswordHasher.cs
│   │   │       └── IJwtTokenGenerator.cs
│   │   └── Auth/
│   │       ├── Register/
│   │       │   ├── RegisterCommand.cs
│   │       │   └── RegisterResponse.cs
│   │       ├── Login/
│   │       │   ├── LoginCommand.cs
│   │       │   ├── LoginResponse.cs
│   │       │   └── AuthUserDto.cs
│   │       ├── IAuthService.cs
│   │       └── AuthService.cs
│   │
│   ├── BCSMS.Infrastructure/
│   │   ├── Security/
│   │   │   ├── PasswordHasher.cs
│   │   │   ├── JwtSettings.cs
│   │   │   └── JwtTokenGenerator.cs
│   │   └── Persistence/
│   │       ├── Configurations/
│   │       │   └── UserConfiguration.cs (+ PasswordHash)
│   │       └── Repositories/
│   │           └── UserRepository.cs (+ GetByEmailAsync, ExistsByEmailAsync, AddAsync)
│   │
│   └── BCSMS.API/
│       ├── Controllers/
│       │   ├── ApiControllerBase.cs
│       │   ├── AuthController.cs
│       │   └── ServiceRequestsController.cs
│       ├── Contracts/
│       │   ├── Auth/
│       │   │   ├── RegisterRequest.cs
│       │   │   └── LoginRequest.cs
│       │   └── ServiceRequests/
│       │       └── CreateServiceRequestApiRequest.cs (NO CitizenId from client)
│       ├── Middleware/
│       │   └── ExceptionHandlingMiddleware.cs (ProblemDetails)
│       └── appsettings.Development.json (+ JwtSettings)
│
└── tests/
    └── BCSMS.IntegrationTests/
        ├── Infrastructure/
        │   └── CustomWebApplicationFactory.cs
        ├── Auth/
        │   └── AuthEndpointsTests.cs
        └── ServiceRequests/
            └── ServiceRequestEndpointsTests.cs
```

---

## 3. Security & Authentication Design

### Password Hashing
- `IPasswordHasher` abstraction in `BCSMS.Application.Abstractions.Security`.
- Concrete implementation `BCSMS.Infrastructure.Security.PasswordHasher` using `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.PasswordHasher<object>` (PBKDF2 with HMAC-SHA256, 100,000 iterations, cryptographically secure 128-bit salt).

### JWT Tokens
- `IJwtTokenGenerator` abstraction returning `(string Token, DateTime ExpiresAt)`.
- Concrete implementation in `BCSMS.Infrastructure.Security.JwtTokenGenerator` using `System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt`.
- Claims included:
  - `ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier` (`sub` / User ID)
  - `ClaimTypes.Email`
  - `ClaimTypes.Role` (`UserRole` name, e.g. `"Citizen"`)
- Key/Issuer/Audience/Expiry configured via `JwtSettings` from `IConfiguration`.

### Authorization
- `[Authorize(Roles = "Citizen")]` on `ServiceRequestsController`.
- Controller extracts `CurrentUserId` from `User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value`.
- Client input **cannot** specify `CitizenId` — it is unconditionally injected from the verified JWT claims.

---

## 4. API Endpoints & Contracts

### 1. `POST /api/auth/register` (Public)
- **Body**: `RegisterRequest` (`FirstName`, `LastName`, `Email`, `PhoneNumber?`, `Password`)
- **Behavior**: Validates fields, checks email uniqueness, hashes password, creates Citizen `User`, persists, returns `201 Created` with `RegisterResponse` (`Id`, `FirstName`, `LastName`, `Email`, `Role`, `CreatedAt`).

### 2. `POST /api/auth/login` (Public)
- **Body**: `LoginRequest` (`Email`, `Password`)
- **Behavior**: Retrieves user by normalized email, checks active status, verifies password hash, generates JWT, returns `200 OK` with `LoginResponse` (`AccessToken`, `ExpiresAt`, `User`).

### 3. `POST /api/service-requests` (Authorize: Citizen)
- **Body**: `CreateServiceRequestApiRequest` (`Title`, `Description?`, `CategoryId`, `Latitude?`, `Longitude?`, `AddressText?`) — **NO CitizenId field**.
- **Behavior**: Injects `CitizenId = CurrentUserId`, calls `_serviceRequestService.CreateAsync`, returns `201 Created` with `CreatedAtAction`.

### 4. `GET /api/service-requests/my` (Authorize: Citizen)
- **Query**: `status?`, `pageNumber`, `pageSize`.
- **Behavior**: Injects `CitizenId = CurrentUserId`, calls `_serviceRequestService.GetMyRequestsAsync`, returns `200 OK` with `PagedResult<ServiceRequestSummaryDto>`.

### 5. `GET /api/service-requests/{id}` (Authorize: Citizen)
- **Route**: `id` (`Guid`).
- **Behavior**: Injects `RequestingUserId = CurrentUserId`, calls `_serviceRequestService.GetByIdAsync`, returns `200 OK` with `ServiceRequestDetailDto`.

---

## 5. Global Exception Handling (ProblemDetails)

`ExceptionHandlingMiddleware` catches unhandled exceptions and outputs RFC 7807 `ProblemDetails`:

| Exception Type | HTTP Status | Response Details |
|---|---|---|
| `ValidationException` | `400 Bad Request` | Detail contains validation message |
| `NotFoundException` | `404 Not Found` | Detail contains resource missing message |
| `ForbiddenException` | `403 Forbidden` | Detail contains forbidden message |
| `ApplicationConflictException` | `409 Conflict` | Detail contains conflict explanation |
| `DomainException` | `422 Unprocessable Entity` | Detail contains domain invariant rule message |
| `Exception` (unhandled) | `500 Internal Server Error` | Generic message, no stack trace exposed |

---

## 6. Swagger JWT Authentication

Configured in `Program.cs` via Swashbuckle:
- Adds `"Bearer"` `SecurityDefinition` (API Key in Header with format `Bearer {token}`).
- Adds `SecurityRequirement` so Swagger UI shows the `Authorize` padlock button and includes the token in requests.

---

## 7. Integration Testing Strategy

- `BCSMS.IntegrationTests` uses `CustomWebApplicationFactory` with `Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.InMemory` database.
- Each test class gets an isolated in-memory database instance.
- Tests will cover:
  1. Citizen registration succeeds (`201`)
  2. Duplicate email registration rejected (`409`)
  3. Valid login returns JWT token (`200`)
  4. Invalid credentials rejected (`400/401`)
  5. Unauthenticated request to `/api/service-requests` returns `401 Unauthorized`
  6. Authenticated citizen creates request successfully (`201 Created`)
  7. Client cannot spoof `CitizenId` — request is bound to authenticated user
  8. Authenticated citizen retrieves their own requests (`200 OK`)
  9. Citizen cannot retrieve another citizen's request (`403 Forbidden`)
  10. Invalid/expired token returns `401 Unauthorized`

---

## 8. Verification Plan

1. `dotnet restore BCSMS.sln`
2. `dotnet build BCSMS.sln` (0 errors, 0 warnings)
3. `dotnet test BCSMS.sln` (all unit & integration tests pass)
4. Verify Swagger JWT setup and endpoint routing

## 2. User Knowledge

- **Context:** Municipal citizen service platform for Bursa Metropolitan Municipality (BCSMS).
- **Architecture Constraints:** ASP.NET Core .NET 8, Clean Architecture, framework-independent Domain (0 NuGet packages), Fluent API EF Core 8 in Infrastructure, no generic repositories/UnitOfWork, no MediatR/CQRS.
- **Password Storage Decision:** "Use Option A for this MVP: `PasswordHash` may be stored on the existing `User` entity. Domain must never perform hashing, salting, verification, or cryptographic operations. Password hashing and verification remain behind `IPasswordHasher` in Application with the concrete implementation in Infrastructure."
- **Login Failure Model:** "Login must behave identically for: nonexistent email, incorrect password, otherwise invalid credentials. Return a generic authentication response such as: `Invalid email or password.` Do not expose whether an email address exists."
- **Integration Test DB Rule:** "Do NOT use `Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.InMemory` for API integration tests. Use SQLite in-memory instead. Integration test architecture: `WebApplicationFactory` -> ASP.NET Core API -> EF Core -> SQLite In-Memory."
- **Controller Rule:** "Keep controllers thin. An `ApiControllerBase` is not required merely to extract the authenticated user ID. Prefer a small API-layer ClaimsPrincipal extension/helper when it keeps the controllers clearer, for example conceptually: `User.GetUserId()`."

## 2. API Endpoints

| Method | Route | Auth Role | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/auth/register` | Public (Anonymous) | Registers a new Citizen |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/login` | Public (Anonymous) | Authenticates and returns JWT |
| `POST` | `/api/service-requests` | `Citizen` | Creates request for authenticated citizen |
| `GET` | `/api/service-requests/my` | `Citizen` | Retrieves authenticated citizen's requests |
| `GET` | `/api/service-requests/{id}` | `Citizen` | Retrieves request detail if owned by citizen |

---

## 3. JWT Claims Structure & Mapping

- **Subject (`sub` / `ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier`)**: `User.Id` (Guid string)
- **Email (`email` / `ClaimTypes.Email`)**: `User.Contact.Email`
- **Role (`role` / `ClaimTypes.Role`)**: `User.Role` (e.g. `"Citizen"`)
- **JTI (`jti`)**: Unique token identifier Guid
- **Claim Mapping**: `TokenValidationParameters` has `RoleClaimType = ClaimTypes.Role` and `NameClaimType = ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier`. `User.GetUserId()` extension method extracts the user identifier.

---

## 4. Exception-to-HTTP Status Mapping

| Exception | HTTP Status | Title |

### Phase 5: Authentication, Authorization & Web API Report

Phase 5 is complete. The secure ASP.NET Core Web API with JWT authentication, role-based authorization, centralized ProblemDetails exception handling, and full SQLite in-memory integration test suite is implemented and passing.

---

### 1. Domain Changes and Justification

- **Change**: Added `public string PasswordHash { get; private set; }` to [`BCSMS.Domain.Entities.User`](file:///Users/mervebilgin/BursaCityServiceManagement/backend/dotnet/src/BCSMS.Domain/Entities/User.cs).
- **Justification**: Storing the pre-computed hash string directly on the `User` aggregate root allows a clean, single-table design without requiring an extra `UserCredential` table/join. The Domain remains completely framework-independent and performs **zero** cryptographic, salting, or hashing operations.

---

### 2. Authentication Architecture

- **Registration**: `POST /api/auth/register` accepts `RegisterRequest` (`FirstName`, `LastName`, `Email`, `PhoneNumber?`, `Password`). Public registration hardcodes `UserRole.Citizen` and `departmentId = null`. Roles such as `Employee`, `Manager`, or `Admin` cannot be registered publicly.
- **Login**: `POST /api/auth/login` accepts `LoginRequest` (`Email`, `Password`).
- **Timing / Enumeration Protection**: Nonexistent emails, inactive users, and incorrect passwords throw an identical `UnauthorizedException("Invalid email or password.")` resulting in a generic 401 response.

---

### 3. Password Hashing Implementation

- Abstraction: [`IPasswordHasher`](file:///Users/mervebilgin/BursaCityServiceManagement/backend/dotnet/src/BCSMS.Application/Abstractions/Security/IPasswordHasher.cs) in Application.
- Implementation: [`PasswordHasher`](file:///Users/mervebilgin/BursaCityServiceManagement/backend/dotnet/src/BCSMS.Infrastructure/Security/PasswordHasher.cs) in Infrastructure using `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.PasswordHasher<object>` (PBKDF2 with HMAC-SHA256, 100,000 iterations, cryptographically secure 128-bit random salt).
- Plaintext passwords are never persisted. Verification uses cryptographic constant-time comparison.

---

### 4. JWT Configuration, Claims & Mapping

- Abstraction: [`IJwtTokenGenerator`](file:///Users/mervebilgin/BursaCityServiceManagement/backend/dotnet/src/BCSMS.Application/Abstractions/Security/IJwtTokenGenerator.cs) in Application.
- Implementation: [`JwtTokenGenerator`](file:///Users/mervebilgin/BursaCityServiceManagement/backend/dotnet/src/BCSMS.Infrastructure/Security/JwtTokenGenerator.cs) in Infrastructure.
- Configuration: [`JwtSettings`](file:///Users/mervebilgin/BursaCityServiceManagement/backend/dotnet/src/BCSMS.Infrastructure/Security/JwtSettings.cs) (`Issuer`, `Audience`, `Secret`, `ExpiryMinutes`).
- **JWT Claims emitted**:
  - `sub` / `ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier`: User ID (`Guid`)
  - `email` / `ClaimTypes.Email`: User email
  - `role` / `ClaimTypes.Role`: `UserRole` string (e.g. `"Citizen"`)
  - `jti`: Unique token identifier (`Guid`)
- **Claim Extraction**: [`ClaimsPrincipalExtensions.GetUserId()`](file:///Users/mervebilgin/BursaCityServiceManagement/backend/dotnet/src/BCSMS.API/Extensions/ClaimsPrincipalExtensions.cs) extracts `User.GetUserId()` directly from the validated claims.

---

### 5. Authorization Model & Identity Enforcement

- Controller endpoints are decorated with `[Authorize(Roles = "Citizen")]`.
- **Identity Invariant**: The client input contracts (e.g. `CreateServiceRequestApiRequest`) **do not contain `CitizenId`**. The controller unconditionally extracts `citizenId = User.GetUserId()` from the verified JWT claims before invoking Application use cases, making identity spoofing impossible.

---

### 6. API Endpoints

| Method | Route | Authorization | Request Body | Response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/auth/register` | Anonymous | `RegisterRequest` | `201 Created` (`RegisterResponse`) |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/login` | Anonymous | `LoginRequest` | `200 OK` (`LoginResponse` with JWT) |
| `POST` | `/api/service-requests` | `Citizen` | `CreateServiceRequestApiRequest` | `201 Created` (`Location` header + `CreateServiceRequestResponse`) |
| `GET` | `/api/service-requests/my` | `Citizen` | Query (`status?`, `pageNumber`, `pageSize`) | `200 OK` (`PagedResult<ServiceRequestSummaryDto>`) |
| `GET` | `/api/service-requests/{id}` | `Citizen` | Route `id` (`Guid`) | `200 OK` (`ServiceRequestDetailDto`) |

---

### 7. Exception-to-HTTP Status Mapping

The [`ExceptionHandlingMiddleware`](file:///Users/mervebilgin/BursaCityServiceManagement/backend/dotnet/src/BCSMS.API/Middleware/ExceptionHandlingMiddleware.cs) catches application/domain exceptions and outputs RFC 7807 `ProblemDetails`:

| Exception Type | HTTP Status | Response Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ValidationException` | `400 Bad Request` | Application input validation errors |
| `UnauthorizedException` | `401 Unauthorized` | Invalid email/password or authentication failure |
| `ForbiddenException` | `403 Forbidden` | Ownership violation or unauthorized role |
| `NotFoundException` | `404 Not Found` | Entity not found |
| `ApplicationConflictException` | `409 Conflict` | Duplicate email or inactive resource |
| `DomainException` | `422 Unprocessable Entity` | Domain invariant / state machine rule violation |
| `Exception` (unhandled) | `500 Internal Server Error` | Generic message (no internal stack trace exposed) |

---

### 8. Swagger Bearer Configuration

Configured in [`Program.cs`](file:///Users/mervebilgin/BursaCityServiceManagement/backend/dotnet/src/BCSMS.API/Program.cs):

- Swagger UI includes the **Authorize** lock button, allowing evaluators to paste `Bearer {token}` and test authenticated endpoints directly in the browser.

- **Strategy**: SQLite In-Memory database using [`CustomWebApplicationFactory`](file:///Users/mervebilgin/BursaCityServiceManagement/backend/dotnet/tests/BCSMS.IntegrationTests/Infrastructure/CustomWebApplicationFactory.cs).
- **Isolation**: A dedicated in-memory SQLite connection is opened and retained for each test run, with schemas generated via `EnsureCreated()`.

# Real API Smoke Test Report

## Summary

A live HTTP API smoke test was executed against the running ASP.NET Core application on `http://localhost:5123`.

All flows (A through H), authentication, authorization, ownership security, and Swagger Bearer integration passed with zero runtime errors.

---

## Smoke Test Results by Step

### 1. API Startup
- **Result**: `BCSMS.API` started and bound to `http://localhost:5123` with Kestrel in `Development` hosting environment.
- **Log**: `Now listening on: http://localhost:5123`.

---

### 2. Database & Migration Status
- **Result**: Development database initialized at `src/BCSMS.API/bcsms.db` with all tables (`Users`, `Departments`, `Categories`, `ServiceRequests`, `StatusHistoryEntries`, `Comments`, `Attachments`).
- **Initial Category**: Seeded category `"Street Lighting and Electrical"` (`11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111`).

---

### 3. Flow A — Registration
- **Request**: `POST /api/auth/register`
- **Payload**:
  ```json
  {
    "firstName": "Murat",
    "lastName": "Bursali",
    "email": "murat.bursali@bursa.bel.tr",
    "phoneNumber": "5551234567",
    "password": "Password123!"
  }
  ```
- **Response**: `201 Created`
  ```json
  {
    "id": "b6e333c6-7c98-4070-9061-5f268de4a2f4",
    "firstName": "Murat",
    "lastName": "Bursali",
    "email": "murat.bursali@bursa.bel.tr",
    "role": 0,
    "createdAt": "2026-08-19T13:20:40.959318Z"
  }
  ```
- **Verification**:
  - Response does not contain `password` or `passwordHash`.
  - User role is `0` (`Citizen`).
  - User is persisted in database with PBKDF2 hash.

---

### 4. Flow B — Login
- **Request**: `POST /api/auth/login`
- **Payload**:
  ```json
  {
    "email": "murat.bursali@bursa.bel.tr",
    "password": "Password123!"
  }
  ```
- **Response**: `200 OK`
  - `accessToken`: JWT signed with HMAC-SHA256
  - `expiresAt`: valid future timestamp
  - `user`: correct user summary
  - Claims verified: `sub = b6e333c6-7c98-4070-9061-5f268de4a2f4`, `email = murat.bursali@bursa.bel.tr`, `role = Citizen`

---

### 5. Flow C — Unauthorized Access
- **Request**: `GET /api/service-requests/my` without Authorization header
- **Response**: `401 Unauthorized` with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer` header.

---

### 6. Flow D — Create Service Request
- **Request**: `POST /api/service-requests` with Bearer JWT
- **Payload**:
  ```json
  {
    "title": "Street light is not working",
    "description": "The street light has been off for two nights.",
    "categoryId": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
    "latitude": 40.195,
    "longitude": 29.060,
    "addressText": "Bursa"
  }
  ```
- **Response**: `201 Created`
  - `Location` header: `http://localhost:5123/api/service-requests/c9f39ee1-0ee0-4b70-a9aa-19b23ebd5756`
  - `citizenId`: `b6e333c6-7c98-4070-9061-5f268de4a2f4` (injected from JWT)
  - `status`: `0` (`RequestStatus.New`)

---

### 7. Flow E — Get My Requests
- **Request**: `GET /api/service-requests/my?pageNumber=1&pageSize=10` with Bearer JWT
- **Response**: `200 OK`
  - `items[0].title`: `"Street light is not working"`
  - `items[0].categoryName`: `"Street Lighting and Electrical"`
  - Pagination: `totalCount: 1`, `totalPages: 1`, `hasPreviousPage: false`, `hasNextPage: false`.

---

### 8. Flow F — Request Detail
- **Request**: `GET /api/service-requests/c9f39ee1-0ee0-4b70-a9aa-19b23ebd5756` with Bearer JWT
- **Response**: `200 OK`
  - `categoryName`: `"Street Lighting and Electrical"`
  - `citizenId`: `b6e333c6-7c98-4070-9061-5f268de4a2f4`
  - `location`: coordinates + address text
  - `statusHistory`: `[]`
  - `comments`: `[]`
  - `attachments`: `[]`

---

### 9. Flow G — Ownership Security
- **Action**: Registered and logged in as a 2nd citizen (`ayse.nilufer@bursa.bel.tr`), then requested 1st citizen's request ID `c9f39ee1-0ee0-4b70-a9aa-19b23ebd5756`.
- **Response**: `403 Forbidden`
  ```json
  {
    "title": "Forbidden",
    "status": 403,
    "detail": "You do not have permission to view this service request.",
    "instance": "/api/service-requests/c9f39ee1-0ee0-4b70-a9aa-19b23ebd5756"
  }
  ```

---

### 10. Flow H — Login Security
- **Wrong Password**: `POST /api/auth/login` -> `401 Unauthorized` with ProblemDetails `{"detail": "Invalid email or password."}`
- **Nonexistent Email**: `POST /api/auth/login` -> `401 Unauthorized` with identical ProblemDetails `{"detail": "Invalid email or password."}`

---

### 11. Swagger Verification
- Swagger UI available at `http://localhost:5123/swagger/index.html`
- OpenAPI JSON available at `http://localhost:5123/swagger/v1/swagger.json`
- `securitySchemes.Bearer` configured as `apiKey` in `header` with format `Bearer {token}`.

---

### 12. Build and Test Verification
```
dotnet restore BCSMS.sln -> Succeeded
dotnet build BCSMS.sln   -> 0 Warnings, 0 Errors
dotnet test BCSMS.sln    -> 38/38 Tests Passed (26 Unit + 12 Integration)
```
